violations.description: Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Different species of raw animal food was not properly separated from each other or arranged according to minimum cooking temperatures. In the walk in cooler a box of raw pork tenderloins was stored touching a box of raw chicken thighs.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. Containers of noodles and chicken in the front reach in cooler did not have a date on them.--Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food was not consumed/discarded within 10 calendar days from the date of preparation. The date on a container of spring rolls was 7/15. The date on a container of sauce was 6/30. The date on a container of cooked chicken was 8/2. These are not properly marked when transferring containers.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. Filters and hood system need to be cleaned.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floors under and behind the cooking equipment need to be cleaned.

General premises. — --Opening to outside or portion of building that is not part of the food establishment, was not protected against the entry of insects and rodents. The back door has a gap between the floor and weather stripping for the back screen door.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. Wood shelf above the three compartment sink is bare wood. Wood supports for the counter for the rice cookers by the soda dispenser are bare wood. Pallet under the chest freezer by the hand sink is bare wood. These must be painted, or sealed.

Food-contact surfaces - Design and construction. — --Multiuse food-contact surfaces did not meet design and/or construction requirements. Several containers in the walk in cooler used for food storage were black. Food contact surfaces must be light colored.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. The hood system over the stove needs to be cleaned.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. The walls, ceilings, and lights in the kitchen need to be cleaned.

Lighting. — --Light intensity for areas of handwash, warewash, equipment/utensil storage, food offering or toilet room * was insufficient. The lights in the dish area are not working and the light provided is insufficient to show the accumulation of dirt and debris.
